text_block_list.text: Passing by the school gates on a day off—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, Curren just got back too♪ Metabolism 
boost and detox from the bedrock bath!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehh, "just as usual"~? Are you suuure~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll go work up a sweat for just a 
little bit longer, then?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother, could you bring Curren's bag 
to the dorm for me?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, could you bring Curren's bag to 
the dorms for me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wants to go out and run, round and 
round. So, pretty please?
choice_data_list:
Want me to help out with your independent 
training too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because this special training is gonna 
banish every single bit of Curren's 
puffiness and complacency!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So for now, will you let Curren try hard 
on her own?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, there's something else I want to 
ask you to help me with, Big Brother. 
Eheh☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, there's something else I want to 
ask you to help me with, Big Sister. Eheh☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Help out by saying "Cute!" a whoooole 
bunch when Curren gets all pretty and 
cute♪

Later on, Curren Chan came to report with 
a refreshed smile, declaring, "My diet was 
a huge success~♪"
